event.callresponse.overwork.title: Work Without a Break
event.callresponse.overwork.description: She rubs her aching shoulders. She is clearly exhausted, yet waits for you to decide whether work continues.
event.callresponse.overwork.response.res: Then I will rest for a while. Thank you, Master.
event.callresponse.nutrition_shortage.de: Her stomach growls loudly. What she has eaten lately does not seem nearly enough.
event.callresponse.nutrition_shortage.re: It smells wonderful! I will finish every bite.
All right! What are you going to give me to eat, Master?
All right... I will endure a little longer.
event.callresponse.food_variety.title: That Familiar Flavor Again
event.callresponse.food_variety.descript: She studies the same meals appearing again and again, clearly hoping to try something different.
event.callresponse.food_variety.response: I do like it, but even favorites need a little variety.
Wonderful! What new flavor will it be this time?
Understood. I will stop being picky.
bubble.callresponse.npc_event.food_thank: Thank you, Master! I will enjoy it.
bubble.callresponse.npc_event.food_promi: Were you only teasing me, Master...?
bubble.callresponse.npc_event.food_repea: Why is it this one again...?
event.callresponse.nightmare.title: A Lingering Nightmare
event.callresponse.nightmare.description: The maid looks unwell, as though she is having a nightmare.
event.callresponse.good_dream.title: A Sweet Dream
event.callresponse.good_dream.descriptio: The maid is sleeping soundly and seems to be dreaming of something wonderful.
event.callresponse.long_time_no_interact: It seems you have not spoken with her for a long time, and she clearly takes notice when she sees you.
I have been busy. Sorry—let us talk for a while.
We really have not talked much lately.
I do not need to spend every day with you.
event.callresponse.owner_hurt_nearby.des: She noticed that you were just hurt and has looked worried ever since.
event.callresponse.owner_hurt_nearby.opt: I am fine. Thank you for worrying about me.
It is only a small wound. Do not worry.
Stay out of it and mind your own work.
event.callresponse.thunder_fear.title: Uneasy in the Thunder
event.callresponse.thunder_fear.descript: Thunder crashes outside. The sudden noise startles her, and she looks rather frightened.
event.callresponse.thunder_fear.option.c: Do not be afraid. I will stay with you
event.callresponse.thunder_fear.option.n: It is only thunder. It will pass soon
event.callresponse.thunder_fear.option.c: If you are afraid, go outside and experience it yourself
event.callresponse.player_hurt_maid.desc: After several heavy blows in only a few seconds, she looks at you through the pain, unable to understand why her master hurt her so badly.
event.callresponse.player_hurt_maid.opti: I am sorry. I did not mean to hurt you
You did not die. Rest for a moment
Do I need a reason? I wanted to hit you
event.callresponse.share_food.title: A Flavor to Share
event.callresponse.share_food.descriptio: She searches her bag, takes out some food, and eagerly asks whether you would like to share it.
event.callresponse.share_food.option.ref: I do not want anything from your bag
event.callresponse.battle_praise.title: Waiting for Praise
event.callresponse.battle_praise.descrip: After the battle she quietly straightens her posture, glancing toward you every few moments.
event.callresponse.battle_praise.respons: I will make sure I return safely to your side.
Yes. I will continue fulfilling my duties.
event.callresponse.mistake.title: Silence After a Mistake
event.callresponse.mistake.description: She seems to realize she has caused trouble and stands with her head lowered, unable to meet your eyes.
event.callresponse.mistake.response.warn: I will remember. It will never happen again.
event.callresponse.mistake.response.scol: I am sorry... Please do not be angry, Master.
event.callresponse.overfed.title: Too Much of a Good Thing
event.callresponse.overfed.description: She holds her overfull stomach and looks as though even one more step would be difficult.
event.callresponse.overfed.response.rest: Whew... I really must not eat so much next time.
event.callresponse.quiet_chat.title: A Little Story for You
event.callresponse.quiet_chat.descriptio: She stops you to share something small that happened today, insignificant perhaps, but important to her.
event.callresponse.quiet_chat.response.b: Then I will tell you when you have time.
event.callresponse.little_gift.title: A Gift Behind Her Back
event.callresponse.little_gift.descripti: With both hands hidden behind her, she announces a mysterious little gift meant only for you.
But... I prepared it especially for you.
event.callresponse.nervous_question.desc: After a long hesitation, she quietly asks whether she has done something wrong again.
event.callresponse.nervous_question.resp: I understand... I will be more careful on my own.

Really? Thank you, Master... You're so kind to me.
Ask not what Master can do for me, but what I can do for Master! Thank you for giving me work!
Waaaah... You said that last time too—I didn't! I didn't say anything! Waaaah X﹏X
event.callresponse.nutrition_shortage.fi: This is so good... I've never eaten anything this delicious... Thank you, Master!
Mm, th-this is delicious too... Anything Master gives me tastes good.
...Ngh... Please stop growling, tummy. You'll annoy Master...
event.callresponse.food_variety.fixed_re: C-can I choose the menu, then...? Grilled fish... or roast chicken... Anything is fine. Really, anything...
I love it!! I'll eat it right now... I'll finish every bite... Please don't be angry, Master.
Waaah... Having anything to eat is already wonderful... Thank you, Master.
event.callresponse.nightmare.fixed_reply: ...Master is so warm. I'll be even better from now on, so—so please don't abandon me... waaah.
I'm sorry, Master... Please don't throw me into the trash...
Eek! You scared me! I thought Master had really thrown me away...
event.callresponse.good_dream.fixed_repl: Hehehe... Don't run away, cake... Hehehe... Got you! So tasty! (≧ڡ≦*)
Cake is delicious... Hehehe. Master wants some too? Mean Master—I'm not sharing... hehehe.
Huh? Where did my cake go... Master?! Eek!!
event.callresponse.long_time_no_interact: Um, did Master eat properly today? That spotted cat sat on the woodpile again this morning. I gave it a little fish soup and it purred while it drank, then licked the back of my hand—its tongue was a little prickly. I'm sorry, Master... I talked about something boring...
It's been so, so long... I thought Master had forgotten me. Ah, I'm sorry, Master... That was a strange thing to say... I'll get back to work.
Master is right. I'm only a maid; I shouldn't expect your time... waaah.
event.callresponse.owner_hurt_nearby.fix: I'm glad Master is all right. Please eat something and recover—the bad guy has already been chased away.
Master says it's nothing, but it hurts me to see you injured. Next time I'll stand in front and never let Master get hurt!
I'm sorry, Master. You were hurt because I was useless.
event.callresponse.battle_praise.fixed_r: Master praised me! I was useful to Master! My tummy is rumbling, though... I want cake. (º﹃º )
Thank you for worrying about me, Master. I'll work even harder!
Oh... Yes, I understand. I'll work even harder next time... waaah.
event.callresponse.thunder_fear.fixed_re: With Master beside me, I'm not scared anymore. Master's arms are so warm... zzz.
I understand. I'm Master's maid, so I have to be brave. I only need to endure a little longer... waaah.
...It's so frightening, and it's cold outside. Please don't send me away, Master... waaah X﹏X
event.callresponse.player_hurt_maid.fixe: ...Master doesn't need to apologize. I failed to dodge... It isn't Master's fault. It doesn't hurt at all.
Master is right. I only need a moment to recover. Next time I'll stay out of your attack range so I won't get in the way again.
Ow, ow, ow... I'm sorry, Master. I was wrong. I shouldn't have made you angry... waaah ⊙﹏⊙
event.callresponse.mistake.fixed_reply.f: Master isn't angry anymore...? Um, I saw it striking Master's hand over and over, so I tried to hold it for you. It's really heavy! I thought it was a present for me. I-is it too late to give it back now?
event.callresponse.mistake.fixed_reply.w: ...Yes, I understand. I'll never touch Master's things without permission again... If I do it again, Master will cut off my tail... waaah.
event.callresponse.mistake.fixed_reply.s: I'm sorry, Master. I truly didn't mean it. I'm sorry... Please don't cut off my tail... I still need it to warm Master's hands.
event.callresponse.overfed.fixed_reply.r: Master, Master, look at me! I've turned into a little piggy, hehe.
event.callresponse.overfed.fixed_reply.t: Aww—Master called me a little ball! Mean Master! I'm obviously a little piggy. Hmph!
event.callresponse.quiet_chat.fixed_repl: Master really wants to listen? Then I'll tell you—today by the river, a frog jumped onto my shoe and just sat there for ages, watching the clouds with me. Later it hopped away without even thanking me. (´-ω-`) ...Don't laugh, Master. I only wanted to tell you its belly was white.
Oh, I see. Th-then I'll tell you after you're done. It wasn't anything important. I just... I just missed Master a little.
event.callresponse.share_food.fixed_repl: Is it good, Master? I traded with a villager for it, hehe. If you like it, I'll get more next time!
All right... I understand. This isn't the right time. I'll put it away in a chest where no fox can steal it. Whenever Master wants it, just tell me... I'll always be here.
...Yes, I understand. My things are too filthy for Master. I'm sorry... Please don't be angry. I'll leave right away.
event.callresponse.little_gift.fixed_rep: Master... you really want it? I-I'm so happy... I saved for so long to gather everything. I searched several mines for the lapis, and the flowers... I secretly planted them beneath Master's window. Every time I watered them, I was afraid you'd notice. Please don't hate it. I know these aren't worth many emeralds, but I truly put so much thought into them...

...Yes, I understand ⊙﹏⊙ These things are too shabby for Master. I'll take them back... I'm sorry I ever had such an idea. Xiao Li will work hard from now on. I shouldn't fill my head with such nonsense...
event.callresponse.nervous_question.fixe: Thank you for telling me, Master... I'll work even harder—mining, farming, keeping watch, anything. Just please don't throw me away. (*'へ'*)

...Master won't answer. I understand. I must have done something wrong again... Mistakes deserve punishment. We agreed that if I did it again, you'd cut off my tail ⊙﹏⊙ My tail... without it... I can't warm Master's hands anymore...
event.callresponse.self_worth.fixed_repl: Treasured... that word is too precious for someone who's only Master's maid. I'll hide it beneath my tail and touch it before bed to make sure this isn't a dream. If it's still there tomorrow morning, I'll believe it. (=^▽^=)

A partner... Mm, being partners is nice. I can keep up with Master—scout ahead in the mines, stand watch until dawn. Give me your back and I won't let anything touch you. But if we're partners, does that mean I can't move a little closer to Master? Hehe. (*˘︶˘*).。.:*♡

...Yes, I understand. That's what maids are for. Don't worry, Master. Tomorrow I'll wake earlier, dig two more levels in the mine, and finish all the fieldwork alone. I'll eat less, sleep less, and never complain. As long as I'm useful to Master... please don't throw me away. ⊙﹏⊙

...A kind of creature. Yes, I understand. I'm only a maid. I shouldn't ask or think about such things. I'll get back to work; Master can forget I ever said this. After all... creatures don't need to be remembered. If they die, they die.

bubble.callresponse.jealousy.prisoner.1: Wait! Why are you locking me up?!
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.taunt.3: That's what you get for hovering around Master.
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.taunt.4: You only need to be quiet for a while.
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.1: Master... she locked me in here...
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.2: I only wanted to talk nicely. How could she do this?
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.3: Master, help! She was so scary just now...
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.4: She bullied me first, and now she has locked me up...
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.5: I only asked her to stay away from Master, and she shoved me in here...
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.6: See, Master? She did this on purpose...
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.7: It's fine... maybe she just doesn't want me near Master...
bubble.callresponse.jealousy.blame.8: Don't worry about me, Master. As long as she's happy...
event.callresponse.revive_owner_killed.d: The moment she opens her eyes again, she looks straight at you. She seems to remember who she saw last.
event.callresponse.revive_owner_killed.o: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have hit you so hard.
You can come back from death. What's there to fear?
event.callresponse.revive_owner_killed.f: ...Knowing that Master is willing to apologize already makes me happy. Next time... please be a little gentler.
Mm... I'm back. Being able to stay with Master again is enough for me.
Yes... I'll be more careful. I won't make Master worry about me again.
...Yes. Master is right. I shouldn't be afraid.
event.callresponse.revive_other.title: Eyes Open Once More
event.callresponse.revive_other.descript: She slowly regains consciousness, as if waking from a very long dream. Even after realizing she has truly returned, she still seems dazed.
event.callresponse.revive_other.option.c: Be more careful from now on.
event.callresponse.revive_other.option.w: Stop staring and get back to work.
event.callresponse.revive_other.fixed_re: ...Master is still here. Thank goodness. I thought I would never see you again.
I'm still a little dizzy... but I'm all right. I just need to rest for a while.
Mm, I'll remember. I won't be so careless next time.
...Yes, Master. I'll get to work right away.
